title: On Replacing the broken pane in an hour
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：replace　|　正文 365 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 replace 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the keeper ① replaced the broken pane in an hour without a word of thanks, and every child in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② replaces the broken pane in an hour at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ replace the broken pane in an hour at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ replaced the broken pane in an hour before — a line in the register for March 1984 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Replacing the broken pane in an hour without a word of thanks, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ replace the book on the middle shelf at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Replace the book on the middle shelf at once and never mention it again.

By 1997 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the register, and a new child from the next zoo ⑧ replaces the book on the middle shelf without a word of thanks every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ replaced the broken pane in an hour again when nobody else would.

⑩ To replace the broken pane in an hour, my mother said in 2002, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the zoo remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the zoo forgets, somebody replaces the broken pane in an hour at once again and somebody must replace the broken pane in an hour without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 替换（一般过去式 replaced the broken pane in an hour：1990 年饲养员头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 替换（一般现在 replaces the broken pane in an hour：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 替换（不定式 to replace the broken pane in an hour：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 替换（过去完成时 had replaced the broken pane in an hour：1984 年三月的饲养台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 替换（动名词 replacing the broken pane in an hour 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 放回（replace the book on the middle shelf：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去放回把书放回架子中间一层）
G. v. 放回（replace the book on the middle shelf：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 替换（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 replaces the book on the middle shelf，而母亲又一次 replaced the broken pane in an hour）

answers: In 1990 the keeper replaced the broken pane in an hour without a word of thanks, and every child in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three seasons on, the keeper still replaces the broken pane in an hour at once without being asked.
My mother said later that to replace the broken pane in an hour at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had replaced the broken pane in an hour long before 1997, and the line in the register for March proves it.
Replacing the broken pane in an hour without a word of thanks, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 replace 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1990 the keeper replaced the broken pane in an hour without a word of thanks, and nobody in the zoo forgot it.
Even now the keeper replaces the broken pane in an hour at once whenever the zoo asks.
Replacing the broken pane in an hour without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever replace the book on the middle shelf at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next zoo replaces the book on the middle shelf without a word of thanks every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother replaced the broken pane in an hour again, and the zoo remembered that half.
